companies.name: FSB d.o.o.
companies.description: Leading Croatian fire protection company with over 30 years of experience. We specialize in design, implementation, and supervision of fire protection systems in all types of buildings.

companies.name: FSB SOLUTIONS d.o.o.
companies.description: Sister company specialized in distribution and technical support of top-quality fire protection products. We represent leading European manufacturers and provide complete technical support.

jobs.title: Fire Protection Project Manager
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced project manager to coordinate fire protection work execution on demanding projects throughout Croatia. Join our team and work on the most challenging projects in the region.
responsibilities: Planning and coordinating fire protection work execution
Leading project team and collaborating with subcontractors
Communication with investors and supervising engineers
Monitoring project progress and quality control
Ensuring compliance with deadlines and budgets
requirements: Higher education in technical field (civil engineering, mechanical engineering, or similar)
Minimum 5 years of project management experience

jobs.title: Fire Sealing Installation Technician
jobs.description: We are looking for motivated installation technicians for fire sealing installation on construction sites. We offer training and certification for working with the latest materials and technologies.
responsibilities: Installing fire sealing according to project documentation
Working with different types of penetrations (cables, pipes, combined)
Collaborating with project manager and other team members
requirements: Willingness to work at heights and in confined spaces
benefits: Regular salary and per diems for field work

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: Join our sales team as a sales engineer and represent premium fire protection products to our clients. Ideal position for technical professionals with sales skills.
responsibilities: Developing and maintaining relationships with existing clients
Technical presentation of products and solutions
Participating in trade fairs and professional events
requirements: Minimum 2 years of technical sales experience
